_what: Every E8/E9 rel32 whose SITE lies outside the union of all defined function bodies and whose resolved target (site+5+rel32) lands inside a defined function. These are the call edges tools/data/call_graph_no_crt.json cannot see, because an undefined source has no node. See docs/dead-ends.md G167.
_classes: CODE-DISASM: a real decoded instruction at the site. CODE-PSEUDO: undecoded, but a coherent stream lands on the boundary. SUBSUMED: an operand byte of another instruction. DATA-DEFINED: inside a defined Data object. RAW: undecoded and unreached -- needs judgement.

calibration._what: the CODE-PSEUDO test run over pure DATA: every fire is a false positive, so this is the class's noise floor. Read CODE-PSEUDO as 'not obviously data', never as proof.
